<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#f7f1e8">
<title>Lucía y Mateo · BOTÁNICA — Edición cinematográfica</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
 --paper:#f7f1e8;--ink:#4b3b2d;--moss:#6c715a;--ochre:#9d775b;--muted:#776c60;
 --serif:"Cormorant Garamond", "EB Garamond", Georgia,serif;
 --sans:"DM Sans","Avenir Next",Arial,sans-serif;
 --gutter:clamp(24px,7.5vw,68px);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--paper);scroll-behavior:smooth;overflow-x:clip}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
button,a{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}[hidden]{display:none!important}
img,video{display:block;max-width:100%}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ochre);outline-offset:4px}
h1,h2,h3,p,figure{margin:0}
#invitation{width:100%;overflow-x:clip;background:var(--paper);position:relative}
.serif{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.italic{font-style:italic;font-weight:400}
.label{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.205em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#867365}
.bodycopy{font-size:clamp(14px,3.8vw,16px);line-height:1.64;letter-spacing:-.012em;color:#6b6055}
.inner{width:100%;max-width:770px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter);min-width:0;position:relative;z-index:2}
/* Cover is native cinematic footage. The lower edge actually dissolves into the ground. */
.cover{height:100svh;min-height:620px;position:relative;display:grid;align-items:center;justify-items:center;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.cover video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;z-index:-2}
.cover:after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(247,241,232,.04) 0%,rgba(247,241,232,.06) 58%,rgba(247,241,232,.4) 84%,var(--paper) 100%)}
.cover-content{text-align:center;width:100%;padding:16vh var(--gutter) 18vh}
.cover .label{color:#433a30;letter-spacing:.29em}
.hero-names{margin:28px auto 23px;display:grid;justify-items:center;width:100%;line-height:.7}
.hero-name{display:block;max-width:100%;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(87px,25vw,140px);letter-spacing:-.07em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:.74}
.hero-name.long{font-size:clamp(52px,17vw,104px);line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.055em}
.hero-name.xlong{font-size:clamp(39px,12vw,75px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.cover .hero-name:first-child{animation:nameIn 1.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.68,.27,1) .12s both}
.cover .hero-and{animation:nameIn 1.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.68,.27,1) .42s both}
.cover .hero-name:last-child{animation:nameIn 1.45s cubic-bezier(.2,.68,.27,1) .65s both}
@keyframes nameIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(11px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.hero-and{display:block;font:italic 400 clamp(42px,11vw,60px)/.78 var(--serif);color:#926e53;margin:10px 0 7px}
.cover-date{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;font-weight:600}
.cover-location{margin-top:11px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.07em}
.swipe{position:absolute;bottom:max(30px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 18px));left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.82}
/* Continuous film-body: no section-specific backgrounds, no fixed/sticky backgrounds. */
.journey{position:relative;background:var(--paper);isolation:isolate}
.chapter{position:relative;padding:0;min-width:0}
/* Video was PRECOMPOSITED to exactly var(--paper) on every perimeter pixel: no CSS masks. */
.film-breath{position:absolute;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;width:min(110vw,650px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:540/946;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);}
.film-breath video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.film-breath.poster{background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.film-breath--begin{right:-12vw;top:2%;opacity:.94}
.film-breath--agenda{right:-8vw;top:6%;opacity:.86}
.film-breath--gallery{left:-18vw;bottom:-7%;opacity:.70;transform:scaleX(-1)}
/* Luminous counting: not a slide; photograph continues directly into the story. */
.intro{padding-top:2vh}
.intro .inner{padding-bottom:20px}
.intro .label{margin-bottom:11px}
.count-stat{position:relative;padding-top:3vh}
.count-num{font:400 clamp(108px,30vw,163px)/.8 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.10em;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums}
.count-unit{margin-top:2px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.25em;font-weight:600}
.count-phrase{margin-top:32px;max-width:10ch;font-size:clamp(54px,14vw,81px);line-height:.83;text-wrap:balance}
.count-phrase em{font-weight:400;color:#8f6e53}
.count-body{max-width:31ch;margin-top:18px}
/* A candid portrait is the bridge: no card, no fake frame, no black tint. */
.photo-interlude{margin-top:20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.photo-interlude img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3.7;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 42%;animation:photographBreathe 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes photographBreathe{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.028)}}
.photo-interlude::before{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;left:0;right:0;top:-1px;height:11%;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--paper),transparent);}
.photo-interlude::after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:18%;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,var(--paper));}
.story{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:32px}
.story .inner{padding-top:0}
.story h2{font-size:clamp(57px,15.4vw,86px);line-height:.82;max-width:10ch;margin:15px 0 17px;text-wrap:balance}
.story h2 em{font-weight:400;color:#8a6853}
.story p{max-width:34ch}
/* Places are a run in the story, photo and words belong to same paper. */
.places{padding-top:26px;padding-bottom:26px}
.places-heading{margin-bottom:22px}
.places-heading h2{font-size:clamp(56px,14vw,87px);line-height:.85;margin-top:8px}
.place{margin:0 0 26px;min-width:0;position:relative}
.place-image{position:relative;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1.4;overflow:hidden}
.place-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 46%;animation:photographBreathe 21s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.place-image:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-1px;height:15%;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--paper),transparent)}
.place-image:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:27%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--paper))}
.place-copy{position:relative;max-width:770px;margin:-2px auto 0;padding:0 var(--gutter) 8px;z-index:2}
.place-label{color:#90765e;margin:1px 0 6px}
.place-name{font-size:clamp(48px,13vw,79px);line-height:.85;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.place-where{margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#66594e}
.place-address{font-size:13px;color:#75685d;line-height:1.5;margin-top:3px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.place-link{margin-top:14px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid #ab9987;border-radius:100px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.places--empty{display:none}
/* Wedding timetable: bespoke editorial score, not tabular SaaS boxes or flower-pointer diagrams. */
.score{padding-top:26px;padding-bottom:26px}
.score .label{margin-bottom:8px}
.score h2{font-size:clamp(60px,15.4vw,88px);line-height:.83;max-width:11ch;margin-bottom:30px;overflow-wrap:normal}
.score h2 em{font-weight:400;color:#8d7158}
.score-list{display:grid;gap:0;width:100%;position:relative;padding-right:6px}
.score-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:18px;padding:16px 0 15px;min-width:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(95,75,59,.17)}
.score-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.score-time{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.085em;font-weight:600;color:#957359;padding-top:10px}
.score-text{min-width:0}
.score-text h3{font-size:clamp(35px,9vw,48px);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.045em;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.score-text p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;color:#75695f;padding-top:7px}
/* A02 cinema is local but ends in exactly the underlying paper: not a free-floating geometric layer. */
.score .film-breath{opacity:.82}
/* Practical: readable touch interface: all of row clickable, clear plus but no arrows. */
.late-world{position:relative;isolation:isolate}.late-world .film-breath{right:-12vw;top:6%;opacity:.70}
.practical{padding-top:34px;padding-bottom:36px}
.practical .label{margin-bottom:9px;font-size:clamp(13px,3.4vw,15px);letter-spacing:.17em;line-height:1.4}
.practical h2{font-size:clamp(58px,15.4vw,88px);line-height:.81;max-width:10ch;margin-bottom:28px;}
.practical-list{border-top:1px solid rgba(95,75,59,.30)}
.prac-row{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(95,75,59,.30)}
.prac-trigger{appearance:none;background:none;color:inherit;border:0;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:17px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 42px;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:90px}
.prac-trigger .micro{display:block;color:#9a765b;font-size:clamp(12px,3.2vw,14px);line-height:1.35;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
.prac-trigger strong{font:400 clamp(33px,8.5vw,45px)/.92 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.04em;display:block;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.prac-trigger .desc{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#726359;margin-top:5px}
.plus{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(94,69,50,.44);border-radius:50%;font-size:25px;line-height:1;color:#70543c;transition:transform .25s}
.prac-row.open .plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.prac-detail{display:none;padding:0 32px 17px 0;color:#695a4d;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.prac-row.open .prac-detail{display:block}
/* Photographs have full natural colour; the couple, not a filter, takes centre stage. */
.gallery{padding-top:22px;padding-bottom:32px}
.gallery .label{font-size:clamp(14px,3.65vw,16px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;line-height:1.4;color:#6d5442}
.gallery h2{font-size:clamp(59px,15.5vw,91px);line-height:.8;margin:8px 0 20px;max-width:10ch}
.gallery-strip{display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;padding:0 var(--gutter) 0;min-width:0}
.gallery-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.gallery-shot{margin:0;flex:0 0 min(76vw,420px);scroll-snap-align:start}
.gallery-shot img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:.8;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;}
.gallery-note{margin-top:13px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#83705f}
.dots{display:flex;gap:6px}.dots i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#a9a096;opacity:.5}.dots i.on{background:#6d5442;opacity:1}
/* Final RSVP and closing are ONE act of cinema, no blank outro. */
.finale{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(88px,12vh,130px) 24px max(8vh,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));text-align:center}
.finale video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;z-index:-2;filter:brightness(1.01) saturate(1)}
.finale:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(247,241,232,.20) 0%,rgba(247,241,232,.14) 14%,rgba(247,241,232,.01) 36%,rgba(247,241,232,0) 100%)}
.finale h2{font-size:clamp(74px,20vw,121px);max-width:7ch;line-height:.78;margin:25px 0 20px}
.finale p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;margin:0 auto 24px}
.finale .label{font-size:clamp(15px,3.65vw,17px);line-height:1.4;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.165em;color:#513e30;text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(247,241,232,.93),0 0 6px rgba(247,241,232,.76)}
.rsvp{min-height:54px;padding:14px 27px;min-width:220px;background:#644d3b;border:1px solid rgba(64,42,23,.15);border-radius:999px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.finale-sign{position:relative;isolation:isolate;width:min(100%,560px);margin-top:clamp(43px,8vh,74px);display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:9px;padding:0 6px 3px}
/* Soft optical light only behind the lower sign-off: no panel edges or changes to the moving film. */
.finale-sign::after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;inset:-30px -22px -31px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 58% 57% at 50% 68%,rgba(247,241,232,.87) 0%,rgba(247,241,232,.75) 47%,rgba(247,241,232,.28) 76%,rgba(247,241,232,0) 100%);filter:blur(9px)}
.finale-sign::before{content:"";width:60px;height:1px;background:#7a6250;margin-bottom:18px;justify-self:center}
.finale-sign .names{font-size:clamp(37px,10.5vw,55px);line-height:1;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:82vw;justify-self:center;text-align:center;width:100%}
.finale-sign .date{font-size:clamp(13px,3.35vw,15px);line-height:1.42;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.055em;max-width:100%;text-wrap:balance;color:#4b3b2d;text-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(247,241,232,.72)}
.finale-sign .thanks{font-size:clamp(15px,3.65vw,17px);font-weight:500;color:#49392d;max-width:28ch;line-height:1.46;margin-top:9px;text-wrap:balance;text-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(247,241,232,.65)}
/* Only functional dialog during review. Production action routes come from GUEST engine. */
dialog{border:0;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #2d221c44;padding:27px;max-width:min(88vw,430px);font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(39,30,22,.45)}dialog h2{font:400 39px/.95 var(--serif);margin:0 0 15px}dialog p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}dialog button{background:#644d3b;color:white;border:none;border-radius:100px;padding:12px 20px;margin-top:20px}
@media(min-width:700px){.photo-interlude{max-width:680px;margin-inline:auto}.place-image{max-width:800px;margin-inline:auto}.place-copy{max-width:800px}.journey{max-width:1040px;margin-inline:auto}.film-breath--begin{right:0}.film-breath--agenda{right:0}}
@media(max-width:350px){.score-row{grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);gap:11px}.score-text h3{font-size:33px}.hero-name{font-size:84px}.score h2,.practical h2{font-size:53px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cover .hero-name:first-child,.cover .hero-name:last-child,.cover .hero-and,.photo-interlude img,.place-image img{animation:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}.film-breath video{display:none}.film-breath{background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}}

/* GUEST D02 · AJUSTE PUNTUAL DE LEGIBILIDAD (08/10/2026)
   Revisión adicional: cierre final con frase inferior más baja y centrada (08/10/2026)
   Sobre el master congelado: no cambia videos, medios, arquitectura ni experiencia.
   Para aprobar por revisión visual Android; el bloque práctico no se rediseña. */
.cover .label{font-size:clamp(15px,3.85vw,18px);line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.21em;text-shadow:0 1px 7px rgba(247,241,232,.6)}
.cover-date{font-size:clamp(13px,3.35vw,15px);letter-spacing:.19em}
.cover-location{font-size:clamp(14px,3.6vw,17px)}
.swipe{font-size:clamp(11px,2.95vw,13px);letter-spacing:.18em}
.intro .label,.story .label,.places-heading .label,.place-label{
  font-size:clamp(15px,3.8vw,18px);line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.15em;
  font-weight:700;color:#6c5140;
}
.count-unit{font-size:clamp(15px,3.85vw,18px);letter-spacing:.18em;color:#624a39}
.bodycopy{font-size:clamp(17px,4.35vw,20px);line-height:1.57;color:#584b41}
.count-body{max-width:33ch}
.story p{max-width:35ch}
.place-label{margin-bottom:8px}
.place-where,.place-address{font-size:clamp(15px,3.75vw,17px);line-height:1.54}
.score-time{font-size:clamp(16px,4.05vw,19px);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#735038;padding-top:4px}
.score-row{grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:16px}
.score-text p{font-size:clamp(14px,3.55vw,16px);line-height:1.45}
/* Práctico: SOLO legibilidad de cabeceras y títulos menores. */
.practical .label{font-size:clamp(16px,3.95vw,19px);line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.13em}
.prac-trigger .micro{font-size:clamp(15px,3.85vw,18px);letter-spacing:.11em;line-height:1.4}
.gallery .label{font-size:clamp(17px,4.15vw,20px);letter-spacing:.11em;line-height:1.4}
.finale .label{font-size:clamp(18px,4.7vw,22px);letter-spacing:.115em;line-height:1.3;color:#433124;text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(247,241,232,.92),0 0 3px var(--paper)}
/* Ajuste óptico de titular en el cierre: la palabra larga no debe salir del viewport. */
.finale h2{font-size:clamp(58px,16.3vw,96px);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.05em;max-width:100%;width:100%;display:grid;justify-items:center;text-align:center;margin-inline:auto}.finale h2 .lead{display:block;line-height:.92}.finale h2 em{display:block;line-height:.9;font-style:italic}
/* La dedicatoria sube visualmente y gana contraste sin paneles ni recuadros. */
.finale-sign{margin-top:clamp(18px,3.6vh,34px);gap:12px;width:min(100%,560px);padding:0 14px 3px;justify-items:start;text-align:left}
.finale-sign::after{display:none}
.finale-sign .date{font-size:clamp(14px,3.55vw,17px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:0;color:#2f241b;text-shadow:0 0 2px rgba(247,241,232,.28);max-width:none;text-wrap:normal;white-space:nowrap;justify-self:center;text-align:center;width:100%}
.finale-sign .thanks{font-size:clamp(13px,3.3vw,15px);line-height:1.3;color:#1f1711;text-shadow:0 0 2px rgba(247,241,232,.18);max-width:none;text-wrap:normal;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:26px;position:relative;top:34px;left:0;letter-spacing:-.01em;justify-self:center;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:350px){.score-row{grid-template-columns:65px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px}}


/* BOTÁNICA — final content layout. Media, film-breath, late-world and original transitions untouched. */
.score{padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:45px}
.score h2{font-size:clamp(58px,15.4vw,88px);margin-bottom:24px}
.score-list{padding:0}
.score-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:71px minmax(0,1fr);gap:17px;padding:11px 0 12px;border-bottom:0;align-items:baseline}
.score-time{font-size:clamp(15px,3.8vw,18px);letter-spacing:.012em;padding-top:0;color:#765440;font-weight:700}
.score-text h3{font-size:clamp(37px,9.4vw,52px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.score-text p{display:none!important}
.practical{padding-top:52px;padding-bottom:24px}
.practical .label{font-size:clamp(15px,3.8vw,18px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}
.practical h2{font-size:clamp(59px,15.4vw,88px);line-height:.82;margin-bottom:11px}
.practical h2 em{color:#8a6853}
.practical-list{border:0;display:grid;gap:0}
.atelier-note{border:0;min-width:0;padding:9px 0 11px;position:relative}
.atelier-note + .atelier-note{border-top:1px solid rgba(95,75,59,.19);padding-top:11px}
.atelier-note-body{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:0}
.atelier-category{display:block;flex:0 0 100%;font-size:clamp(12px,3.25vw,14px);font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#765b47;margin-bottom:3px}
.atelier-note-title{display:block;flex:0 0 100%;font-size:clamp(34px,9.1vw,48px);letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.04;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.atelier-note-summary{flex:1 1 100%;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:400;line-height:1.38;letter-spacing:-.016em;font-size:clamp(16px,4vw,18px);color:#504438;margin-top:5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.atelier-actions{display:flex;flex:0 0 100%;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px}
.atelier-action{appearance:none;min-height:36px;border:1px solid #816b57;background:rgba(247,241,232,.65);color:#483729;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.1;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(13px,3.5vw,15px);font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.atelier-action:first-child{background:#644d3b;border-color:#644d3b;color:#fff}
.atelier-action:not(:first-child){border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #816b57;background:transparent;color:#483729;border-radius:0;padding:7px 0;font-weight:600}
/* Cormorant Garamond & DM Sans are inherited from the master: no new font requests. */
@media(min-width:600px){.atelier-note-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;column-gap:20px}.atelier-category,.atelier-note-title,.atelier-note-summary{grid-column:1}.atelier-actions{grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 3;align-self:end;justify-content:flex-end}}
@media(max-width:359px){.score-row{grid-template-columns:62px minmax(0,1fr);gap:11px}.practical{padding-top:44px}}


/* BOTÁNICA — agenda restaurada sobre el mismo fondo aprobado.
   Se mantiene el lenguaje editorial y se introduce una línea vertical premium
   entre hora y texto, con un movimiento muy sutil de avance. */
.score{isolation:isolate;padding-top:clamp(35px,6vh,60px);padding-bottom:clamp(65px,8vh,90px)}
.score .inner{position:relative;z-index:3}
.score .label{margin-bottom:12px}
.score h2{font-size:clamp(58px,15.4vw,88px);max-width:11ch;line-height:.82;margin-bottom:24px}
.score-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;position:relative;z-index:2;padding:2px 0 0;overflow:visible}
/* Un trazo de seda estable y otro dibujado a medida que se recorre la agenda. */
.score-list:before,.score-list:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:var(--agenda-track-top,30px);left:var(--agenda-track-x,88px);height:var(--agenda-track-height,280px);border-radius:9px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.score-list:before{width:1px;background:rgba(116,87,67,.34)}
.score-list:after{width:2px;margin-left:-.5px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#9a8068,#76543d 65%,#ad8c73);transform:scaleY(var(--agenda-progress,0));transform-origin:top center;transition:transform 90ms linear;box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(143,103,75,.15)}
.score-row{position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:grid;grid-template-columns:clamp(58px,16vw,82px) clamp(28px,7vw,36px) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:clamp(12px,3.2vw,20px);align-items:center;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:0;padding:10px 0 14px;border:0;min-width:0;text-align:left}
.score-time{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(14px,3.55vw,16px);letter-spacing:.14em;color:#7b5d49;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:right;padding:0;opacity:.82;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity .45s ease,transform .62s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color .42s ease,text-shadow .45s ease}
.score-divider{position:relative;display:block;align-self:stretch;min-height:52px;overflow:visible}
.score-divider:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.86);width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#8a6a54;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(247,241,232,.78);transition:background-color .28s ease,box-shadow .28s ease,transform .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.score-text{position:relative;min-width:0;padding-left:clamp(3px,.9vw,9px)}
.score-text h3{font-size:clamp(31px,8.9vw,47px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:break-word;color:#5b4334;opacity:.76;transform:translateX(10px) translateY(3px);text-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0);transition:opacity .48s ease,transform .78s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color .48s ease,text-shadow .62s ease,letter-spacing .62s ease}
.score-row:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:clamp(70px,19vw,94px);right:-10px;top:6px;bottom:6px;border-radius:28px;background:radial-gradient(115% 90% at 0% 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.76) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.28) 38%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 74%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12),rgba(255,255,255,0));opacity:0;transform:translateX(14px) scale(.98);transition:opacity .55s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.score-text:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(clamp(3px,.9vw,9px) * -1);top:50%;width:clamp(26px,6.4vw,34px);height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(122,91,70,.06) 0%,rgba(122,91,70,.52) 52%,rgba(122,91,70,.88) 100%);transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(.14);transform-origin:right center;opacity:0;transition:transform .72s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .45s ease,box-shadow .55s ease}
.score-text:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:4%;bottom:-8px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(122,91,70,.18),rgba(122,91,70,.06) 60%,rgba(122,91,70,0));opacity:0;transform:scaleX(.82);transform-origin:left center;transition:opacity .45s ease,transform .72s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);pointer-events:none}
.score .film-breath{z-index:0;opacity:.86}
.score-row.is-current:before{opacity:1;transform:none}
.score-row.is-passed:before{opacity:.36;transform:none}
.score-row.is-current .score-divider:before{background:#6c503c;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(247,241,232,.84),0 0 0 7px rgba(129,95,70,.10),0 0 16px rgba(129,95,70,.18);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.18)}
.score-row.is-passed .score-divider:before{background:#674b38;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(247,241,232,.8),0 0 0 5px rgba(116,86,63,.12);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05)}
.score-row.is-current .score-time,.score-row.is-passed .score-time{opacity:1;transform:none;color:#694d3a}.score-row.is-current .score-time{text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(155,124,100,.08)}
.score-row.is-passed .score-text:before{opacity:.45;transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(.52)}
.score-row.is-current .score-text:before{opacity:1;transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(1);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(139,108,86,.10)}
.score-row.is-passed .score-text:after{opacity:.22;transform:scaleX(.92)}
.score-row.is-current .score-text:after{opacity:.48;transform:scaleX(1)}
.score-row.is-passed .score-text h3{opacity:.98;transform:none;color:#4e3a2d}.score-row.is-current .score-text h3{opacity:1;transform:none;color:#4a3428;text-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(141,111,89,.12);letter-spacing:-.045em}
.score:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:clamp(90px,12vh,120px);z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(247,241,232,0),rgba(247,241,232,.65) 40%,var(--paper) 100%)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.score-list:after{transition:none}.score-row:before,.score-text:before,.score-text:after,.score-time,.score-text h3{transition:none;transform:none;opacity:1;filter:none;text-shadow:none}}
/* Dos capítulos completos con una transición de papel entre ambos, nunca una arista. */
.practical{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding-top:clamp(57px,7vh,75px);padding-bottom:clamp(35px,7vh,68px)}
.practical .inner{position:relative;z-index:3}
.practical:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-2px;left:0;right:0;height:clamp(78px,11vh,120px);z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--paper) 0%,rgba(247,241,232,.95) 15%,rgba(247,241,232,0) 100%)}
/* Datos de cada opción una vez, acciones verdaderas, composición contenida. */
.practical h2{margin-bottom:18px}
.atelier-note{padding:10px 0 13px}
.atelier-note + .atelier-note{padding-top:13px}
.atelier-note-title{font-size:clamp(33px,8.5vw,45px)}
.atelier-note-summary{font-size:clamp(16px,4vw,18px);line-height:1.38}
.atelier-actions{margin-top:7px;gap:14px}
.atelier-action{min-height:38px;padding:9px 18px}
/* Entrada al cierre: primero el mismo papel de Galería, después las flores cinematográficas.
   La parte inferior del cierre aprobado, sus letras y el vídeo permanecen intactos. */
.finale:before{background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--paper) 0%,rgba(247,241,232,.99) 5%,rgba(247,241,232,.88) 12%,rgba(247,241,232,.56) 21%,rgba(247,241,232,.12) 33%,rgba(247,241,232,0) 44%)}
@media(max-width:350px){.score-row{grid-template-columns:54px 24px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:10px}.score-text h3{font-size:clamp(29px,9.1vw,36px)}.score-divider{min-height:46px}.practical h2{font-size:53px}}


/* AGENDA / fix 2026-10-09: stable legible text, single active moment.
   Scoped strictly to #agenda. The backdrop, transitions, other blocks are untouched. */
#agenda .score-time{opacity:.96;transform:none;transition:color .36s ease,opacity .36s ease}
#agenda .score-text h3{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#4e3a2d;transition:color .38s ease,text-shadow .45s ease}
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3{opacity:1;transform:none;letter-spacing:-.04em;animation:agendaTypeFocus .62s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
#agenda .score-row.is-passed .score-text h3{opacity:1;transform:none;letter-spacing:-.04em;animation:none}
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-time{animation:agendaTimeFocus .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
#agenda .score-row.is-passed .score-time{animation:none}
#agenda .score-row:before{opacity:0!important;transform:none!important}
@keyframes agendaTypeFocus{0%{opacity:.86;transform:translateY(5px);color:#80634d}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);color:#4a3428}}
@keyframes agendaTimeFocus{0%{opacity:.8;transform:translateY(3px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3,#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-time{animation:none}}
</style>

@keyframes agendaConnectorSweep{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(.14)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes agendaTypeLuxury{0%{opacity:.84;transform:translateY(6px);letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#856650}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);letter-spacing:-.045em;color:#4a372c}}
@keyframes agendaTimeLuxury{0%{opacity:.82;transform:translateY(3px);color:#846753}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);color:#72523e}}
@keyframes agendaDotPulse{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.82)}55%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.24)}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.16)}}

<style id="botanica-premium-integral-v6">
/* Editorial intervention, scoped to agenda and practical only. Cinematic films untouched. */
#agenda .score-row{position:relative;transition:filter .35s ease}

/* Scroll-linked writing accent: its stroke is triggered by the line reaching an event. */
#agenda .score-text h3{position:relative;z-index:1}
#agenda .score-text h3::after{content:"";display:block;position:absolute;left:0;right:15%;bottom:-9px;height:1px;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(.08);opacity:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(99,70,51,.6),rgba(154,117,88,.28) 70%,transparent);pointer-events:none}
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3::after{animation:agendaWrittenStrokeV6 1.05s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}

@keyframes agendaWrittenStrokeV6{0%{opacity:0;transform:scaleX(.05)}35%{opacity:.78}100%{opacity:.68;transform:scaleX(1)}}

@keyframes agendaInkRiseV6{0%{color:#9a7a60;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-shadow:0 0 0 transparent}100%{color:#4a3428;letter-spacing:-.032em;text-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(122,88,66,.09)}}

#practical .atelier-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:12px;margin:10px 0 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .atelier-actions .atelier-action:first-child{min-width:139px;min-height:39px;background:#644d3b;color:#fff;border:1px solid #644d3b;padding:10px 19px;box-shadow:0 9px 19px rgba(91,67,50,.09)}
#practical .atelier-actions .atelier-action:not(:first-child){padding:5px 0 6px;min-height:0;white-space:normal;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #816b57;border-radius:0;color:#493a2e}

#practical .atelier-note--gift .atelier-note-summary{max-width:32ch}
#practical .atelier-note--gift .atelier-actions{margin-top:8px}
/* Hotel: the CTA shares the headline; the information link shares the hotel name. */
#practical .atelier-note--hotel{padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:17px}
#practical .hotel-feature-header{align-items:center;gap:12px}
#practical .hotel-feature-header .atelier-note-title{max-width:8ch;font-size:clamp(31px,8.2vw,39px);line-height:1.0}
#practical .hotel-main-action{flex:0 0 auto;align-self:center}
#practical .hotel-main-action .hotel-primary{display:inline-flex;min-width:128px;min-height:41px;padding:10px 19px;background:#644d3b;color:#fff;border:1px solid #644d3b;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(91,67,50,.12);justify-content:center;align-items:center}

#practical .hotel-other-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:15px;margin-top:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* Visual breathing space before the gallery belongs to gallery, without touching the films. */
#gallery{padding-top:36px}

</style>
<style id="botanica-editorial-folios-v7">
/* Genuine new visual grammar for Práctico: category and action form the editorial
   header, the full-width title follows, and the actual detail is the caption.
   Existing videos, floral backgrounds, Gallery and Cierre remain untouched. */
#practical{padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:44px}
#practical .inner{max-width:540px}
#practical .label{margin-bottom:8px}
#practical h2{margin-bottom:14px}
#practical .practical-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;overflow:visible}
#practical .editorial-entry{
 position:relative;overflow:visible;min-width:0;padding:12px 0 13px;
 border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(104,78,57,.27)!important;
}
#practical .editorial-entry:first-child{border-top:0!important}
#practical .editorial-entry:last-child{padding-bottom:14px}
#practical .editorial-entry-body{display:block;min-width:0}
#practical .editorial-entry::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-1px;left:0;width:34%;height:1px;
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,#89654b,rgba(137,101,75,.38),transparent);
 transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(.2);opacity:.25;
 transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .5s ease}
#practical .editorial-entry:first-child::before{display:none}
#practical .editorial-entry.in-view::before{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.88}
#practical .editorial-entry::after{display:none!important}
#practical .editorial-entry-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-width:0;min-height:35px;margin:0 0 2px}
#practical .editorial-entry .atelier-category{display:block;flex:0 1 auto;
 font:700 clamp(12px,3.25vw,14px)/1.3 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.17em;
 margin:0;color:#765744;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
#practical .editorial-entry-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex:0 0 auto;min-width:0}
#practical .editorial-primary{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
 min-height:36px;min-width:126px;padding:7px 17px;border-radius:99px;
 background:#644d3b;color:#fff;border:1px solid #644d3b;
 font:700 clamp(12px,3.3vw,14px)/1.1 var(--sans);white-space:nowrap;
 text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(91,67,50,.12);
 transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .35s ease}
#practical .editorial-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)}
#practical .editorial-title{display:block;min-width:0;max-width:none!important;
 font:400 clamp(35px,9.25vw,45px)/.98 var(--serif)!important;
 letter-spacing:-.045em;color:#49362b;margin:1px 0 0;
 text-wrap:balance;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#practical .editorial-entry-detail{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:3px 0 0;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0}
#practical .editorial-entry-detail .atelier-note-summary{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;margin:0;
 font:400 clamp(15px,3.8vw,17px)/1.37 var(--sans);
 letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#514438;max-width:none!important;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#practical .editorial-entry-detail .editorial-info{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
 min-height:24px;padding:0 0 3px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(88,65,49,.7);
 border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#533c2e;
 font:700 clamp(13px,3.4vw,15px)/1.1 var(--sans);
 white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:none}
#practical .editorial-entry-extras{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .editorial-entry-extras .atelier-action{padding:0 0 3px;min-height:22px;
 background:transparent!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(88,65,49,.7)!important;
 border-radius:0!important;color:#533c2e!important;box-shadow:none!important;
 font:700 14px/1.1 var(--sans)}
/* The blank stock paper can breathe, but Gallery never collides with Regalo. */
#gallery{padding-top:27px}
@media(max-width:360px){
 #practical .editorial-entry{padding-block:11px 12px}
 #practical .editorial-primary{min-width:118px;padding-inline:13px}
 #practical .editorial-title{font-size:clamp(33px,9vw,39px)!important}
 #practical .editorial-entry-top{gap:9px}
}
@media(max-width:320px){
 #practical .editorial-entry-top{flex-wrap:wrap}
 #practical .editorial-entry-action{margin-left:auto}
}
/* Agenda: a legible ink-and-silk choreography, with no additional subtitle. */
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3{
 animation:agendaSatinTypeV7 .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both!important}
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text:before{
 animation:agendaSatinThreadV7 .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both!important}
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3::after{
 animation:agendaSatinUnderlineV7 .95s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both!important}
#agenda .score-row.is-current .score-divider:before{
 animation:agendaSatinPinV7 .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both!important}
@keyframes agendaSatinTypeV7{
 0%{opacity:.78;transform:translateX(13px);color:#89674e;letter-spacing:-.015em}
 100%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);color:#4a3428;letter-spacing:-.032em}}
@keyframes agendaSatinThreadV7{
 0%{opacity:.12;transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(.15)}
 100%{opacity:.95;transform:translate(calc(-100% - 8px),-50%) scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes agendaSatinUnderlineV7{
 0%{opacity:0;transform:scaleX(.08)}
 100%{opacity:.68;transform:scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes agendaSatinPinV7{
 0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.82)}
 55%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.4)}
 100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 #practical .editorial-entry::before{transition:none;transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.6}
 #agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3,
 #agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text:before,
 #agenda .score-row.is-current .score-text h3::after,
 #agenda .score-row.is-current .score-divider:before{animation:none!important}}
</style>

<style id="botanica-practico-folios-v9">
/* V9: entirely scoped to practical. All original media, transitions and other chapters retained. */
#practical{padding-top:clamp(25px,4vh,42px);padding-bottom:clamp(50px,8vh,72px)}

#practical .label{margin-bottom:7px}
#practical h2{margin-bottom:19px}
#practical .practical-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;overflow:visible}
#practical .v9-scene{display:block;position:relative;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;min-width:0;isolation:isolate}

#practical .v9-content{position:relative;display:block;min-width:0}
#practical .v9-label{font:700 clamp(12px,3.3vw,14px)/1.25 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#86664f;margin-bottom:8px;display:block}
#practical .v9-heading{font:400 clamp(35px,9.25vw,49px)/.95 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.052em;color:#49382c;max-width:none;overflow-wrap:break-word;text-wrap:balance}

#practical .v9-cta{font:700 clamp(13px,3.42vw,15px)/1.2 var(--sans)!important;letter-spacing:0!important;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:42px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .24s ease,color .24s ease,transform .24s ease;max-width:100%}
#practical .v9-cta--filled{background:#644d3b!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #644d3b!important;box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(76,53,37,.09)!important}
#practical .v9-cta--outline{background:rgba(247,241,232,.35)!important;color:#594332!important;border:1px solid rgba(99,76,58,.52)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#practical .v9-cta--quiet{background:transparent!important;color:#574434!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(99,76,58,.68)!important;border-radius:0!important;min-height:30px;padding:4px 0 5px;box-shadow:none!important;font-weight:600!important}
#practical .v9-scene .v9-cta.v9-cta--filled{background:#644d3b!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #644d3b!important;border-radius:999px!important;box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(76,53,37,.09)!important;padding:10px 18px!important;min-height:42px!important;max-width:100%}
#practical .v9-scene .v9-cta.v9-cta--outline{background:rgba(247,241,232,.35)!important;color:#594332!important;border:1px solid rgba(99,76,58,.52)!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:10px 18px!important;min-height:42px!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#practical .v9-scene .v9-cta.v9-cta--quiet{background:transparent!important;color:#574434!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(99,76,58,.68)!important;border-radius:0!important;min-height:30px!important;padding:4px 0 5px!important;box-shadow:none!important;font-weight:600!important}
#practical .v9-scene .v9-cta.v9-cta--filled:active,#practical .v9-scene .v9-cta.v9-cta--outline:active{transform:scale(.98)}
#practical .v9-stroke{display:block;height:1px;width:100%;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(.24);opacity:.34;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(113,84,62,.66) 0%,rgba(113,84,62,.24) 45%,rgba(113,84,62,0) 100%);transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .7s ease}
#practical .v9-scene.in-view .v9-stroke{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.85}
#practical .v9-entry{opacity:.88;transform:translateY(5px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .95s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.25,1)}
#practical .v9-scene.in-view .v9-entry{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* Transport: a miniature printed itinerary with times as graphic material. */
#practical .v9-transport{padding:0 0 11px!important}
#practical .v9-transport .v9-heading{font-size:clamp(35px,9.1vw,46px)}
#practical .v9-transit-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:4px;margin:5px 0 0}

#practical .v9-times{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:clamp(24px,8vw,45px);justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}

#practical .v9-time em{font:700 clamp(10px,2.9vw,12px)/1 var(--sans);font-style:normal;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#8c6a53;text-transform:uppercase}
#practical .v9-time b{font:400 clamp(23px,6.2vw,29px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;color:#4a3528;white-space:normal}
#practical .v9-transit-note{margin-top:7px;font:400 clamp(14px,3.55vw,16px)/1.32 var(--sans);color:#6b5c4e}
#practical .v9-transit-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
#practical .v9-transport .v9-stroke{margin-top:12px}
/* Hotel: one featured destination; data given visual primacy over generic title. */
#practical .v9-hotel{padding:0 0 13px!important}
#practical .v9-hotel .v9-label{margin:0}
#practical .v9-hotel-overline{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:3px}#practical .v9-hotel-intro{font:italic 400 clamp(22px,6.1vw,30px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#765743}
#practical .v9-hotel-feature{margin:4px 0 0;padding:0}
#practical .v9-hotel-name{font:400 clamp(36px,9.5vw,52px)/.95 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.052em;color:#483529;text-wrap:balance;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#practical .v9-hotel-extra{font:400 clamp(14px,3.7vw,16px)/1.3 var(--sans);color:#6b5c4d;margin-top:5px}
#practical .v9-hotel-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:15px;margin-top:7px}
#practical .v9-hotel .v9-stroke{margin-top:12px}
/* Music: a single line of melody and the invitation to participate. */
#practical .v9-music{padding:0 0 12px!important}
#practical .v9-music .v9-label{margin:0 0 6px}
#practical .v9-music .v9-heading{font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(37px,9.9vw,51px);color:#795a45}
#practical .v9-music .v9-summary{max-width:35ch;margin:4px 0 0}
#practical .v9-music-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:5px}
#practical .v9-melody{height:23px;flex:1 1 auto;max-width:150px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#practical .v9-melody:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(121,89,67,.72),rgba(121,89,67,.05))}
#practical .v9-melody:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:calc(50% - 3px);left:7%;height:7px;width:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#a28269;box-shadow:24px 3px 0 -2px #a28269,55px -2px 0 -1px #a28269;animation:v9melody 5.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v9melody{from{transform:translateX(0);opacity:.5}to{transform:translateX(24px);opacity:.8}}
#practical .v9-music .v9-stroke{margin-top:10px}
/* Gift: a typographic signature, not a fourth identical service row. */
#practical .v9-gift{padding:0!important}
#practical .v9-gift .v9-label{margin:0 0 8px}
#practical .v9-gift .v9-heading{font-size:clamp(40px,10.2vw,55px);font-style:italic;color:#785841}#practical .v9-gift-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .v9-gift .v9-summary{max-width:34ch;margin-top:5px}
#practical .v9-gift-foot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:12px;margin:0}
@media(max-width:380px){
 #practical .v9-heading{font-size:clamp(32px,9vw,43px)}
 #practical .v9-transit-meta{gap:5px}
 #practical .v9-times{gap:15px}
 #practical .v9-time b{font-size:clamp(22px,6.2vw,27px)}
 #practical .v9-hotel-name{font-size:clamp(33px,9.25vw,45px)}
 #practical .v9-hotel-actions{gap:13px}
 #practical .v9-music .v9-heading{font-size:clamp(34px,9.6vw,46px)}
}
@media(max-width:345px){#practical .v9-times{gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}#practical .v9-time{gap:5px}#practical .v9-gift-header{gap:6px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#practical .v9-entry,#practical .v9-stroke{transition:none;opacity:1;transform:none}#practical .v9-melody:after{animation:none}}

<style id="botanica-v10-practical-only">
/* Only practical typography, layout and actions. All original backdrop/film layers remain unchanged. */
#practical{padding-top:clamp(26px,4vh,45px);padding-bottom:clamp(50px,8vh,72px)}

#practical>.inner>.label{margin-bottom:8px}
#practical>.inner>h2{margin-bottom:24px}

#practical .v10-body{display:block;position:relative;padding:0;min-width:0}
#practical .v10-label{font:700 clamp(12px,3.35vw,14px)/1.25 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.17em;color:#775944;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
#practical .v10-heading{font:400 clamp(38px,10.0vw,52px)/.94 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.043em;color:#49362b;overflow-wrap:break-word;margin:0;text-wrap:balance}

#practical .v10-button{appearance:none;box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:999px;min-height:43px;padding:10px 21px;font:700 clamp(13px,3.56vw,15px)/1.15 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background-color .28s ease,color .28s ease;max-width:100%}
#practical .v10-button:active{transform:scale(.97)}
#practical .v10-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #76543f;outline-offset:4px}
#practical .v10-button--solid{background:#644d3b!important;border:1px solid #644d3b!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 7px 19px rgba(71,50,37,.10)!important}
#practical .v10-button--outline{background:rgba(247,241,232,.54)!important;border:1px solid rgba(95,69,51,.54)!important;color:#4d3b2c!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#practical .v10-button--text{min-height:35px;padding:4px 0;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:#564130!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(97,75,55,.7)!important;box-shadow:none!important}

#practical .v10-transit-stop span{font-weight:700}
#practical .v10-timeboard{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:13px 0 0;margin:7px 0 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(101,75,57,.35)}
#practical .v10-timeboard::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:-1px;height:2px;width:25%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8f7058,rgba(143,112,88,0));transform-origin:left;animation:v10Thread 3.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#practical .v10-time-group{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;min-width:0}
#practical .v10-time-label{font:700 clamp(11px,3.0vw,13px)/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b6d58}
#practical .v10-time-value{font:500 clamp(18px,4.6vw,21px)/1.12 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#4d392c;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#practical .v10-extra{font:400 clamp(15px,3.8vw,17px)/1.4 var(--sans);margin:7px 0 0;color:#584536}
#practical .v10-transit-actions{display:flex;gap:13px;justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
/* Hotel is the sole typographic hero of Practical. */
#practical .v10-hotel{padding:22px 0 27px!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(101,75,57,.28)!important}
#practical .v10-hotel-intro{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:13px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
#practical .v10-hotel-intro .v10-label{margin:0}
#practical .v10-hotel-subtitle{font:italic 400 clamp(19px,5.0vw,25px)/1 var(--serif);color:#8b6953;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0}
#practical .v10-hotel-name{font:400 clamp(44px,12vw,62px)/.90 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.056em;color:#49362b;margin:0;overflow-wrap:break-word;text-wrap:balance}
#practical .v10-hotel-note{font:400 clamp(15px,3.8vw,17px)/1.35 var(--sans);color:#594a3d;margin:8px 0 0}
#practical .v10-hotel-links{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:15px 24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
/* Distinguish the two personal elements rather than repeating hotel-style rows. */
#practical .v10-music{padding:21px 0 21px!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(101,75,57,.28)!important}
#practical .v10-music .v10-heading{font-style:italic;color:#65503e}
#practical .v10-music .v10-copy{max-width:29ch;margin-top:8px}
#practical .v10-music-actions{margin-top:13px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .v10-gift{border-top:1px solid rgba(101,75,57,.28)!important;padding:20px 0 0!important}
#practical .v10-gift-main{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .v10-gift-title{font:italic 400 clamp(39px,10.5vw,54px)/.96 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#5c4436;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#practical .v10-gift-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
#practical .v10-gift-copy{font:400 clamp(15px,3.85vw,17px)/1.42 var(--sans);color:#564539;margin-top:10px;max-width:35ch}
#gallery{padding-top:clamp(26px,5vh,46px)}
@keyframes v10Thread{from{transform:scaleX(.24);opacity:.4}to{transform:scaleX(2.1);opacity:1}}
@media(max-width:359px){
 #practical .v10-heading{font-size:clamp(35px,9.9vw,43px)}
 #practical .v10-hotel-name{font-size:clamp(42px,11.7vw,50px)}
 #practical .v10-timeboard{gap:8px 13px}
 #practical .v10-hotel-links{gap:10px 19px}
 #practical .v10-gift-title{font-size:clamp(36px,10.2vw,43px)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#practical .v10-timeboard::before{animation:none;transform:none;opacity:.7}}
</style>

<style id="botanica-practico-atelier-compuesto-v11">
/* A separate, deliberately paced typographic chapter. Scoped to Práctico only;
   all original film layers, visual transitions and approved chapters remain intact. */
#practical{padding-top:clamp(29px,4.5vh,45px);padding-bottom:clamp(54px,8vh,74px)}
#practical>.inner{max-width:570px}
#practical>.inner>h2{margin-bottom:clamp(19px,3vh,26px)}
#practical #practicalList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
#practical .v11-item{position:relative;isolation:isolate;border:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:none!important;min-width:0}
#practical .v11-item::before,#practical .v11-item::after{content:none!important;display:none!important}
#practical .v11-body{display:block;position:relative;min-width:0}
#practical .v11-eyebrow{font:700 clamp(13px,3.35vw,14px)/1.25 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.165em;color:#775944;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
#practical .v11-title{font:400 clamp(37px,9.3vw,48px)/.96 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.041em;color:#4b372b;margin:0;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#practical .v11-copy{font:400 clamp(16px,4.0vw,18px)/1.36 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.008em;color:#4e4137;margin:8px 0 0;max-width:35ch;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#practical .v11-note{font:400 clamp(15px,3.85vw,17px)/1.38 var(--sans);color:#57483b;margin:8px 0 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#practical .v11-action{appearance:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-sizing:border-box;text-decoration:none;min-height:43px;padding:9px 19px;max-width:100%;border-radius:999px;font:700 clamp(14px,3.6vw,16px)/1.2 var(--sans);white-space:normal;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .22s ease,transform .22s ease}
#practical .v11-action:active{transform:scale(.98)}
#practical .v11-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #775643;outline-offset:4px}
#practical .v11-action--primary{color:#fff!important;background:#644d3b!important;border:1px solid #644d3b!important;box-shadow:none!important;min-width:122px}
#practical .v11-action--secondary{color:#593f2f!important;background:rgba(247,241,232,.68)!important;border:1px solid rgba(104,79,60,.56)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#practical .v11-action--link{color:#58402f!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(93,68,49,.74)!important;border-radius:0!important;min-height:33px;padding:6px 0 4px;box-shadow:none!important;font-weight:600}
/* Transport is a compact itinerary rather than a list or a faux controls row. */
#practical .v11-transport{padding-bottom:24px!important}
#practical .v11-transport .v11-title{font-size:clamp(38px,9.35vw,48px)}
#practical .v11-stop{font:400 clamp(16px,4vw,18px)/1.3 var(--sans);color:#574537;margin:10px 0 0}
#practical .v11-stop strong{font-weight:700}
#practical .v11-timetable{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:14px;margin-top:15px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(111,82,61,.26)}
#practical .v11-time-cell{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:6px 9px;min-width:0}
#practical .v11-time-cell+.v11-time-cell{padding-left:14px;border-left:1px solid rgba(111,82,61,.22)}
#practical .v11-time-label{font:700 clamp(12px,3.15vw,14px)/1.2 var(--sans);color:#8b6954;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}
#practical .v11-time-value{font:400 clamp(23px,6.2vw,29px)/1.04 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:#4b372b;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#practical .v11-transport-actions{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px}
/* Hotel is the visual focal point, without putting information links at odd heights. */
#practical .v11-hotel{padding:21px 0 24px!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(111,82,61,.26)!important}
#practical .v11-hotel-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:7px}
#practical .v11-hotel-top .v11-eyebrow{margin:0}
#practical .v11-subtitle{font:italic 400 clamp(20px,5.2vw,26px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:#83634f;margin:0}
#practical .v11-hotel-name{font:400 clamp(44px,11.3vw,61px)/.91 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.053em;color:#483428;margin:0;overflow-wrap:break-word;text-wrap:balance}
#practical .v11-hotel-name--long{font-size:clamp(36px,9vw,49px)}
#practical .v11-hotel .v11-note{margin-top:7px}
#practical .v11-hotel-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:9px 20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
/* A gentle typographic coda: two deliberately different rhythms. */
#practical .v11-music{padding:22px 0 23px!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(111,82,61,.24)!important}
#practical .v11-music .v11-title{font-style:italic;color:#674e3e}
#practical .v11-music .v11-copy{max-width:34ch}
#practical .v11-music-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:12px}
#practical .v11-gift{padding:19px 0 0!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(111,82,61,.24)!important}
#practical .v11-gift-intro{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 15px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#practical .v11-gift .v11-title{font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(37px,9.7vw,51px);color:#614735}
#practical .v11-gift-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px}
#practical .v11-gift .v11-copy{margin-top:8px;max-width:34ch}
/* No fake progress bars, graphic flourishes or decorative arrows. */
#practical .v11-item.in-view .v11-title,#practical .v11-item.in-view .v11-hotel-name{animation:v11TypographyRise .65s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
@keyframes v11TypographyRise{from{opacity:.78;transform:translateY(7px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(max-width:359px){#practical .v11-time-value{font-size:21px}#practical .v11-timetable{column-gap:8px}#practical .v11-time-cell+.v11-time-cell{padding-left:10px}#practical .v11-hotel-name{font-size:clamp(40px,11.5vw,48px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#practical .v11-item.in-view .v11-title,#practical .v11-item.in-view .v11-hotel-name{animation:none}}
</style>

</head><body>
<main id="invitation" aria-label="Invitación de boda botánica">
<header class="cover" id="cover"><video id="coverVideo" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="auto" poster="data:image/webp;base64,"></video>
 <div class="cover-content"><span class="label">Nos casamos</span><h1 class="hero-names serif" id="heroNames"></h1><p class="cover-date" id="coverDate"></p><p class="cover-location" id="coverCity"></p></div><div class="swipe">Desliza para descubrirlo</div></header>
<div class="journey">
<section class="intro chapter" id="countdown"><div class="film-breath film-breath--begin" aria-hidden="true"><video class="breathVideo" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/webp;base64,"></video></div>
 <div class="inner"><div class="count-stat"><p class="label">Ya queda menos</p><div class="count-num serif" id="daysNum">—</div><div class="count-unit">DÍAS</div></div>
 <h2 class="count-phrase serif">Qué ganas <em class="italic">de veros.</em></h2>
 <p class="count-body bodycopy" id="countCopy"></p></div>
 <figure class="photo-interlude" id="introPhoto"><img id="heroCouplePhoto" alt="Fotografía de la pareja"></figure></section>
<section class="story chapter" id="story"><div class="inner"><p class="label">Nosotros</p><h2 class="serif" id="storyTitle"></h2><p class="bodycopy" id="storyCopy"></p></div></section>
<section class="places chapter" id="places"><div class="inner places-heading"><p class="label">Nos vemos aquí</p><h2 class="serif">El <em class="italic">lugar.</em></h2></div><div id="placeList"></div></section>
<section class="score chapter" id="agenda"><div class="film-breath film-breath--agenda" aria-hidden="true"><video class="breathVideo" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/webp;base64,"></video></div><div class="inner">
<h2 class="serif">Así lo hemos <em class="italic">imaginado.</em></h2><div class="score-list" id="agendaList"></div></div></section>
<div class="late-world"><div class="film-breath" aria-hidden="true"><video id="glowVideo" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/webp;base64,"></video></div>
<section class="practical chapter" id="practical"><div class="inner"><p class="label">Para tenerlo a mano</p><h2 class="serif">Lo <em class="italic">esencial.</em></h2><div class="practical-list" id="practicalList"></div></div></section>
<section class="gallery chapter" id="gallery"><div class="inner"><p class="label">Un poco de nosotros</p><h2 class="serif">Hasta llegar <em class="italic">aquí.</em></h2></div><div class="gallery-strip" id="galleryTrack" aria-label="Fotografías de la pareja"></div><div class="inner gallery-note"><span id="galleryHint">Desliza para ver más</span><span class="dots" id="galleryDots"></span></div></section>
</div>
</div>
<footer class="finale" id="finale"><video id="finalVideo" muted autoplay loop playsinline preload="auto" poster="data:image/webp;base64,"></video>
<p class="label">Solo falta una cosa</p><h2 class="serif"><span class="lead">¿Nos</span><em class="italic">acompañáis?</em></h2><p>Nos hará muy felices.</p><button class="rsvp" id="rsvp">Confirmar asistencia</button>
<div class="finale-sign"><div class="names serif" id="finalNames"></div><div class="date" id="finalDate"></div><div class="thanks">Gracias por formar parte de este día.</div></div></footer>
</main>
<dialog id="previewDialog"><h2 id="dialogTitle">Invitación de muestra</h2><p id="dialogCopy">En la invitación entregada, esta acción abrirá el sistema GUEST configurado para la pareja.</p><button id="dialogClose" type="button">Volver a la invitación</button></dialog>

const MEDIA={"opening": "data:video/mp4;base64,
